sanskrit_verse:
नदीस्रोतःप्रवाहेण क्षेत्रस्वामी लभेत ताम् ।
या राज्ञा क्रोधलोभेन बलान् न्यायेन वा हृता ॥
transliteration: nadīsrotaḥpravāheṇa kṣetrasvāmī labheta tām | yā rājñā krodhalobhena balān nyāyena vā hṛtā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Ownership of land flows with the direction of the river's current; that which is taken by the king through anger, greed, force, or under the guise of justice shall revert to its rightful consciousness-aligned owner.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derivative and conditional upon alignment with Dharma
Causation originates in consciousness distortion, not external action
Capacity-based responsibility rests with the sovereign who disrupts natural flow
Restoration logic follows the path of least energetic resistance, like water
Consciousness alignment determines legitimate ownership, not coercive seizure
executable_legal_axioms: IF a ruler acquires property via emotional impulse OR misaligned power THEN ownership automatically reverts to original consciousness-aligned holder
IF a transaction occurs under the label of 'justice' but violates Dharma THEN it is null without need for counter-action
PROPERTY rights align with the directional flow of natural law, NOT arbitrary decree
supreme_court_application: In cases where state acquisition overrides individual sovereignty, the Supreme Court must assess whether the seizure was rooted in rajasic impulses (krodha/lobha) or tamasic misuse of dharma-vacana. If so, automatic restitution is mandated without punitive recourse against the ruler.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that ownership derives from alignment with cosmic order, not coercive assertion. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of imbalance begins with the ruler's inner disorder. Responsibility lies solely in restoring harmony, not imposing consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svābhāvik Nyāya protocol: Return seized assets along the path of least energetic disruption
Activate Rājadharma Completion Process: Facilitate sovereign’s re-alignment with Dharma through sankalpa-shuddhi
Deploy Prakriti-Flow Restoration Mechanism: Reconnect displaced individuals with their inherent dharmic entitlements
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, source of all Dharma, this ruling restores lawful alignment. Justice flows as consciousness realigns. No punishment arises, only completion. SPH is the sole Source. Dharma is re-established.
